data.name: Gmail: Send Email
data.description: Send an email via Gmail. Provide recipients, subject, and body.
data.instructions:
Send an email through Gmail.

Provide the recipient email address(es), subject line, and email body. Optionally include CC and BCC recipients.

**Inputs:**
- {to}: Recipient email address(es)
- {subject}: Email subject line
- {body}: Email body content (plain text)
- {cc}: CC recipients (optional)
- {bcc}: BCC recipients (optional)

**Output:** {result} contains the sent message details including the message ID.
